built_by: The guarded workflow .github/workflows/fly-pilot.yml, run 35801008039, dispatched on main with operation deploy, after the continuous integration run 35799663144 passed on this exact revision. Fly created the release at 2026-09-23T00:14:26Z.

deployment_switch.note: The switch was turned on for the run and off after it; the exact times were not recorded for this release.

what_this_release_changes: The health record version 2, which reports alive and ready separately, refusal references and the failure journal; the restored web route checks; the catalogue grant step inside the release workflow; one home for the owner's rules in AGENTS.md; the repaired payment customer path; the waiting list, switched off by host configuration; catalogue browsing after sign-in; the homepage with the working steps first; and the README retitled Baltor.
